Targets enterprise networks primarily in China and other Asian countries
Earlier version targeted public-facing web servers exploiting CVE-2017-5638 (Apache Struts), CVE-2017-12615 (Apache Tomcat), and CVE-2017-10271 (Oracle WebLogic Server)
Impacted Systems: Enterprise environments in Asia (China, South Korea, Japan, Vietnam)
Microsoft Windows systems vulnerable to SMB exploit
Public-facing web servers running Apache Struts, Apache Tomcat, Oracle WebLogic Server

Exploitation of web server vulnerabilities (CVE-2017-5638, CVE-2017-12615, CVE-2017-10271)
